description: This source file implements part of an HTTP proxy component, providing functions for handling request headers and bodies within a proxy system. It defines two functions, HttpApoSbcRequestHeaders and HttpApoSbcRequestBody, which currently perform no processing and simply return a relay mode.

methods.name: ULONG HttpApoSbcRequestHeaders(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,ANSC_HANDLE hSession,ANSC_HANDLE hMessage)
methods.description: Handles proxy behavior for HTTP request headers; currently returns a relay mode without processing.

methods.name: ULONG HttpApoSbcRequestBody(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,ANSC_HANDLE hSession,ANSC_HANDLE hMessage)
methods.description: Handles proxy behavior for HTTP request body; currently returns a relay mode without processing.
